properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 5:27PM PDT until October 21 at 7:45PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
FFWVEF

The National Weather Service in Las Vegas has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Inyo County in south central California...

* Until 745 PM PDT.

* At 527 PM PDT, emergency management reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is
already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Panamint Springs.

Recent thunderstorms have resulted in flooding along Hwy 190 and
around Panamint Valley Road.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.areaDesc: Garfield, UT; Kane, UT; San Juan, UT
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 21 at 12:35PM MDT until October 22 at 12:15PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...San Juan County in southeastern Utah...
Southwestern Garfield County in southern Utah...
Kane County in southern Utah...

* WHEN...Until 1215 PM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of normally dry washes, slot canyons, rivers,
creeks, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations is imminent
or occurring. Prolonged and widespread moderate to heavy rainfall
will continue trough at least Thursday morning. This coupled with
near-saturated soils will allow rapidly increasing flows across all
waterways within the warned area, including all of the Glen Canyon
National Recreation Area. Increasingly high flows are expected in,
but not limited to...the Paria River, Wahweep Creek, Warm Creek,
Last Chance Creek, Croton Canyon, and the Escalante River Basin and
tributaries. Many backcountry roads within this area are expected
to become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1208 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges continue
to indicate heavy rain. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the warned area. Between 0.25 and 0.75 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2.5 inches are possible in
the warned area through Thursday morning.
- Glen Canyon National Recreation Area, including the Escalante
region. Kodachrome State Park, Tropic, Cannonville, Escalante,
and Big Water
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks can become unstable and
unsafe.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 7:02PM MST until October 21 at 7:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 730 PM MST.

* At 702 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Heber-Overgaard, moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Heber-Overgaard, Aripine, Mogollon Airpark and Twin Lake.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 299 and 313. State Route 377
between mile markers 0 and 13. State Route 277 between mile markers
306 and 319.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Tall Timbers County Park.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

CMAMtext: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 7:30 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 7:30 PM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 4:31PM MST until October 21 at 10:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Moenkopi Wash in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 1000 PM MST /1100 PM MDT/.

* At 431 PM MST /531 PM MDT/, a river gauge on the Moenkopi Wash
remains in Major Flood Stage. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Moenkopi Wash.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Moenkopi Wash.

* For Moenkopi Wash at Moenkopi Wash Near Tuba City:
At 1:45pm MST /2:45pm MDT/ the stage was 31.82 feet.
Flood Stage is 27.0 feet.
Forecast: A crest of 30.97 feet is expected at 3:00pm MST /4:00pm
MDT/ Wednesday.
Impacts:
At 27.0 feet: At 27.0 feet water begins to encroach on homes in
lower Moenkopi Village and floods crop fields along the river.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tuba City and Moenkopi.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 160 between mile markers 318 and 321. U.S. Highway 89 between
mile markers 476 and 478. State Route 264 between mile markers 323
and 324.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Moenkopi Wash, Little Colorado River, Hamblin Wash, Begashibito
Wash and Fivemile Wash.
properties.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Moenkopi Wash. Severe debris flows can also be anticipated
across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 21 at 6:16PM PDT until October 21 at 8:15PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
SMWLOX

The National Weather Service in OXNARD has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt. Mugu CA
including Santa Cruz Island...
Outer waters from Santa Cruz Island to San Clemente Island to 60 NM
offshore including San Nicolas and Santa Barbara Islands...
Point Piedras Blancas to Point Sal westward out to 10 NM...
Waters from Pt. Sal to Santa Cruz Island CA and westward 60 nm
including San Miguel and Santa Rosa Islands...

* Until 815 PM PDT.

* At 615 PM PDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 9 nm southwest of Point Sal to 31 nm south of San
Miguel Island, moving east at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts in excess of 50 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Boats could suffer significant structural damage in high
winds. Small craft could capsize in suddenly higher
waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Point Arguello...
Point Conception...
Point Sal...
San Miguel Island...
and Santa Rosa Island.
properties.instruction:
Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

structure.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 21 at 9:21PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.Persistent northeast winds have caused river levels on the St Johns
at Astor to rise into Moderate Flood Stage. The river is forecast to
climb slowly through Moderate Flood Stage through the end of this
week. There is potential for levels to approach Major Flood Stage
next week after northeast winds increase again.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on
or near Wildhog and Bonnet roads become inaccessible with several
inches of water inside homes along the river and canals. Docks at
Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely submerged.
Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with yards
completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads flooded
in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on Juno
Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Wednesday the stage was 3.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Wednesday was 3.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 3.2 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Thursday morning at 1130 AM EDT.
